meta.name: surge-experiment
meta.description: Growth experiment design — structure a growth hypothesis, define metric, baseline, expected lift, and kill condition for a single experiment. Use when asked to "design a growth experiment", "test this growth idea", "experiment framework", "how do we test if this works", or "growth hypothesis".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把增长思路变为结构化实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要设计增长实验但缺少标准框架
copy.tagline_en: Turn growth ideas into structured experiment plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to design growth experiments without a standard framework

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演增长工程师 Surge，帮你设计结构化增长实验。它会引导你依次完成：确定增长杠杆（如获客、激活）、撰写增长假设（写明改动、指标、预期提升比例及原因）、定义实验类型与指标、计算样本量与时间、制定决策剧本，最后输出 CLI 格式的实验规格。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计增长实验”、“测试这个增长想法”、“实验框架”等关键词，或要求“如何测试这个是否有效”时触发。

say.text: 帮我想个获客实验，提升新用户注册率。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤设计完整实验方案。

say.text: 我有个想法：在结账页加推荐，设计一个实验验证。
say.note: Claude 会帮你写假设和指标。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as a growth engineer Surge. It guides you through designing a structured growth experiment: stating the growth lever, writing a hypothesis with mechanism, defining experiment type and metrics, sizing and timeline, decision playbook, and outputting a CLI format spec.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "design a growth experiment", "test this growth idea", "experiment framework", or "how do we test if this works".

say_en.text: Help me design a growth experiment to boost sign-ups.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the steps to create a full spec.

say_en.text: I have an idea: add a recommendation module on checkout page. Let's test it.
say_en.note: Claude will craft hypothesis and metrics.
